The Rosenbauer share

The Rosenbauer share offers investors the opportunity to invest in a world-leading provider of innovative firefighting technology. 

Learn more
Strong performance in a stable industry

Investing in innovation and security

Rosenbauer looks back on more than 160 years of expertise in the firefighting industry and stands for innovation, quality and sustainable value creation. As a listed company on the Vienna Stock Exchange, our shares enable investors to participate in the success of a stable and growing industry. With a clear focus on digitalisation, sustainability and international expansion, we pursue a strategy based on long-term growth and operational excellence.

Rosenbauer continuously invests in research and development to remain at the forefront of the industry in the future. Our advanced solutions and sustainable approaches ensure a safe and efficient future for firefighting worldwide.

At a glance

Equity Story

  • Global market leader
    • System provider for fire-fighting equipment and preventive fire protection
    • World's leading manufacturer of fire engines
  • Unique global network
    • 15 production sites in 8 countries
    • 23 sales and service companies in 18 countries
    • Approx. 160 trading partners worldwide
  • Innovation leader
    • Rosenbauer Group holds around 185 patents
    • Pioneer in sustainability technologies
    • First fully electric fire-fighting vehicle: "Revolutionary Technology" (RT / RTX) model series
    • First complete electric vehicle program (Interschutz 2022)
  • Resilient business model
    • Width diversification across regions and products
    • Clients predominantly from the public sector

Global market leader with strong Austrian owners

Shareholder structure 2026

Rosenbauer is listed with no-par value shares on the Prime Market of the Vienna Stock Exchange. Robau Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH1 holds 55% of the shares, while around 17% are held by Rosenbauer Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH2 , founded by the family shareholders. The remaining 28% is held by retail investors3 in Europe – including France, Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, Austria, Switzerland and Spain – as well as in the USA.

1 Robau Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH
2 Rosenbauer Beteiligungsverwaltung GmbH
3 The non-voting registered shares are allocated to the free float
